Self-service provider & user lifecycle (.today: Credentialing emails a “New Provider Alert” or “Termed” notice. An agent re-keys the provider, NPI/taxonomy, user account, iPad access and templates by hand. Reply-all messages on the same email open extra tickets.
Self-service provider & user lifecycle (.build: A structured onboarding / offboarding form in practice admin. On submit it auto-creates the provider and user, sets an access end-date for terminations, and posts status back to the requester. No ticket needed.
Self-service provider & user lifecycle (.pitch: One form replaces every “New Provider Alert” and termination email.

User-level notification preferences (opt.today: Providers are flooded with “Patient information update” and online-registration emails. Each practice emails support to have them turned off or re-routed, one provider at a time.
User-level notification preferences (opt.build: Per-user notification toggles, plus a practice-level default recipient (e.g. the front-desk inbox). Default these emails to OFF for providers.
User-level notification preferences (opt.pitch: Let providers switch off registration and patient-update emails themselves.

Self-service note unlock / amend / DOS &.today: An agent unlocks signed notes, changes the date of service, or swaps the rendering / billing provider when a practice asks.
Self-service note unlock / amend / DOS &.build: A role-based “Unlock / Amend” action for practice managers. It requires a reason and writes a full audit trail.
Self-service note unlock / amend / DOS &.pitch: Practice managers unlock and correct notes themselves, with an audit trail.

Duplicate patient/encounter/charge detec.today: Agents and Tier 2 manually merge duplicate patient accounts and delete duplicate encounters, charges, copays and CPT lines.
Duplicate patient/encounter/charge detec.build: A possible-duplicate warning at registration and self-registration, a nightly duplicate report, and a practice-level merge tool. Also block system-generated duplicate CPTs.
Duplicate patient/encounter/charge detec.pitch: Stop duplicate patients and charges at the source, and merge the rest in one click.

Practice-configurable lists (document ty.today: Every new document type, cancel reason or library code is a ticket, even though it's just adding a value to a list.
Practice-configurable lists (document ty.build: An admin screen where practices can add, rename and retire document types, cancel reasons and library codes themselves.
Practice-configurable lists (document ty.pitch: Practices add their own document types, cancel reasons and codes.

Practice-configurable billing rules buil.today: Each new exception hold (J-code units, MOD59, INSREG, telehealth, self-pay) is a ticket, and a developer writes the rule.
Practice-configurable billing rules buil.build: Rule templates (code + payer + condition → hold or route) that RCM admins can create and edit, with a test mode and change history.
Practice-configurable billing rules buil.pitch: RCM admins create exception holds and rules without a developer.

Self-service report builder & scheduled.today: There's a ticket for every new column, filter, date range, CSV export or Power BI tweak.
Self-service report builder & scheduled.build: A column picker, saved filters, CSV export on every report, and scheduled email subscriptions. Power BI dataset change requests go through a request form instead of a ticket.
Self-service report builder & scheduled.pitch: Add columns, filters and exports to reports without raising a ticket.

Device enrollment & account self-service.today: An agent enables iPads, unlocks accounts, and adjusts MFA or overseas access.
Device enrollment & account self-service.build: Self-service password reset and unlock, MFA by email or SMS, and an admin toggle to enable or disable a user's iPad.
Device enrollment & account self-service.pitch: Users reset passwords, set up MFA and enable iPads without calling support.

Configurable online-scheduler rules (age.today: Practices raise tickets to block minors, require insurance, stop inactive patients from booking, set first-available, or flag a translator.
Configurable online-scheduler rules (age.build: Per-provider scheduler rules: age range, accepted insurance, new vs established patient, inactive-patient block, deposit or card on file, and a translator question.
Configurable online-scheduler rules (age.pitch: Practices decide who can book online, per provider.

Bulk patient messaging / broadcast (clos.today: Offices ask support to send mass texts (e.g. a power-outage closure) or run patient outreach.
Bulk patient messaging / broadcast (clos.build: Select a day's schedule or a patient list, then send a templated SMS or email with opt-out handling.
Bulk patient messaging / broadcast (clos.pitch: Text a whole day's schedule in seconds, e.g. for an office closure.

Fax routing & webhook self-configuration.today: An agent sets up Documo webhooks, ports fax numbers and configures fax-queue filters.
Fax routing & webhook self-configuration.build: A fax settings page: numbers, webhook setup, routing rules by location, and queue filters.
Fax routing & webhook self-configuration.pitch: Practices manage fax numbers, webhooks and routing themselves.
